verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a first-party built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude browse issues, inspect stack traces, resolve or ignore issues, search logs and detect N+1 queries, so users can operate core triage workflows in natural language. That operation happens only through an external AI client; the product has no native natural-language interface of its own. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, coverage of setup and admin operations (projects, teams, alerts) via natural language, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP workflow.
